GermlinePipeline.output_realignment.description: Output haplotypes and re-aligned reads to a bam file. Default: false.

GermlinePipeline.output_summary_csv.description: Whether to output summary per-locus CSV file. Set to false for large catalogs to reduce I/O.

GermlinePipeline.override_target_interva.description: Override default genome-specific target intervals. If not provided, uses genome-specific default intervals.

GermlinePipeline.p_error.description: Basecalling error for reference confidence model in gvcf

GermlinePipeline.pangenome_haplotypes_in.description: Optional pangenome haplotypes cram index file

GermlinePipeline.pgx_diploid_sampling_in.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: use diploid sampling for haplotypes

GermlinePipeline.pgx_ensemble_size.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: number of augmented passes for ensemble inference (0 disables)

GermlinePipeline.pgx_include_reference_i.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: include the reference among sampled haplotypes

GermlinePipeline.pgx_min_fraction_single.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: minimum fraction of single-strand support for non-SNP variants

GermlinePipeline.pgx_model_onnx.description: (PGx) TensorRT model for calling variants (onnx format)

GermlinePipeline.pgx_num_haplotypes.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: number of haplotypes to sample

GermlinePipeline.pgx_ref_gbz_for_haploty.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: pangenome graph (.gbz) file, required when run_haplotype_sampling is true

GermlinePipeline.pgx_ref_hapl.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: pangenome haplotypes (.hapl) file, required when run_haplotype_sampling is true

GermlinePipeline.pgx_run_haplotype_sampl.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: run haplotype sampling to create pangenome haplotypes (enabled by the PE use-case)

GermlinePipeline.pgx_single_strand_filte.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: enable single-strand filtering (default set by template)

GermlinePipeline.pgx_ug_make_examples_ex.description: (PGx) EfficientDV: extra args passed to make_examples (channels / max-ins-size for PE)

GermlinePipeline.ploidy_file.description: X chromosome ploidy of the cohort and the additional sample. Each sample is represented on a number on a separate row. Ploidy of the default cohort can be found in the template. The last row corresponds to the sample being called. Genome independent.

GermlinePipeline.pon_sgl_file.description: gripss paramter: Panel of normals for single end breakend (partially resolved) calls. Note that the default value is in template

GermlinePipeline.pon_sv_file.description: gripss paramter: panel of normals for breakpoint (fully resolved) calls. Note that the default value is in template

GermlinePipeline.prefilter_query.description: Expression (in bcftools view format) to filter the variants before annotation

GermlinePipeline.prioritize_alt_supporti.description: Generate an image with all available alt-supporting reads, and only then add non-supporting reads

GermlinePipeline.prioritize_high_quality.description: When min-mapq=0, add mapq=0 reads last, only filling remaining image capacity after high-mapq reads

GermlinePipeline.realign_mapq.description: Realignment parameter: Below this value we skip realignment on the supplementary alignment

GermlinePipeline.recalibrate_vaf.description: Whether to recalculate the variant allele frequency on the PASS variants, improves over the naive VAF calculate of DeepVariant (somatic calling only)

GermlinePipeline.ref_dbsnp.description: DbSNP vcf for the annotation of known variants

GermlinePipeline.ref_files_for_tarball.description: List of references for CreateReferenceCache task.

GermlinePipeline.ref_padding.description: Number of bases to extend around the STR repeat region when building auxiliary references for alignment. Larger values provide more flanking sequence context for accurate alignment.

GermlinePipeline.reference_genome.description: (shared: VariantCalling, CNV, SV, STR, HLA, PGx, SegDup) Genome selector: hg38, b37, hg38_taps, hg38_nist_v3, hg38_nist_v3_with_decoy, hg38_no_alt, mm10, mm39. Default to hg38

GermlinePipeline.repeat_mask_file.description: gripss paramter: Repeat mask file. Note that the default value is in template

GermlinePipeline.report_micro_alleles.description: Report micro-alleles (e.g. 15.3) for haploid loci when a partial-repeat insertion is present. REPCN stays the integer floor; the micro-allele decimal appears in the genotype (GT) and a new RCMA VCF/BED field. No-op for diploid loci. Default: off.

GermlinePipeline.roh_af_default.description: Alternate allele frequency assumed for every marker by the ROH caller, in place of a population frequency table

GermlinePipeline.roh_blacklist_override.description: BED of alignment-artefact regions to exclude from the reported runs of homozygosity, overriding the genome default (ENCODE blacklist v2)

GermlinePipeline.run_cnv.description: Run germline CNV calling (cn.MOPS + CNVpytor). Requires bed_graph and ploidy_file

GermlinePipeline.run_giraffe.description: Whether to run Giraffe haplotype aware alignment or not

GermlinePipeline.run_ploidy_estimation.description: Run VCF-based ploidy estimation and chrX/Y haploid conversion for germline samples. Default: false; enabled by germline use cases.

GermlinePipeline.run_roh.description: Whether to call runs of homozygosity (ROH). Enabled by default in the germline WGS use-cases, off otherwise. Requires a reference genome that has a roh_blacklist resource (the hg38 builds and b37) unless roh_blacklist_override is given

GermlinePipeline.run_ua.description: Whether to run UA realignment on the output of the assembly (helps resolving some deletions) or not

GermlinePipeline.run_variant_calling.description: Run SNV/indel variant calling (EfficientDV). Needs a CRAM with real coverage: EfficientDV aborts when the measured median coverage is 0

GermlinePipeline.segdup_model_onnx.description: (SegDup) DeepVariant model for variant calling on segmental duplications, see template

GermlinePipeline.segdup_no_address.description: (SegDup) Start instances with no public IP address

GermlinePipeline.segdup_regions.description: Segmental duplication regions. All reads will be remapped to `segdup_regions` and the calling will happen only on these regions, see template (BED file)

GermlinePipeline.sex_chromosomes.description: Sex chromosome names to exclude from autosomal ploidy baseline. Defaults support chr-prefixed and non-prefixed human references.

GermlinePipeline.shuffle_all_samples.description: Whether to shuffle all samples during inference

GermlinePipeline.skip_figure_generation.description: Skip CNV calls figure generation. Default is: False

GermlinePipeline.skip_filtering.description: Whether to skip CNV filtering step, default is False

GermlinePipeline.spanning_flank_bases.description: Minimum number of bases that must align on each side of the STR repeat region for a read to be considered 'spanning' the locus

GermlinePipeline.str_min_mapping_quality.description: (STR) Minimum mapping quality for reads to be included in analysis

GermlinePipeline.strand_bias_normalizati.description: Thresholds for strand bias normalization. The first value is the lowest strand bias (further from 1:1) to normalize, the second value is the highest strand bias (closest to 1:1) to normalize

GermlinePipeline.strong_call_threshold.description: Probability threshold for selective ensemble inference. When ensemble_size >= 2, examples with max probability below this threshold are re-evaluated using ensemble inference; examples above it are accepted as-is.

GermlinePipeline.sv_calls_vcf.description:
SV calls in VCF format (MANTA-like, single record per SV call) to be used for annotation of combined CNV calls, default is empty and annotation is not performed.
The input tested is the output of structrual_variant_pipeline.wdl

GermlinePipeline.sv_calls_vcf_index.description: Index file for the SV calls VCF

GermlinePipeline.sv_create_md5_checksum_.description: (SV) Create md5 checksum for requested output files

GermlinePipeline.sv_max_reads_per_partit.description: (SV) Assembly parameter: Maximal number of reads that are stored in memory when analyzing an active region

GermlinePipeline.sv_num_shards.description: (SV) Relevant for scatter tasks, which are CreateAssembly and gridss.AnnotateVariants

GermlinePipeline.symbolic_vcf_format.description: Whether to convert the output vcf to the region format or not, default True

GermlinePipeline.t1k_index_tar.description: T1K index tar.gz containing hlaidx/ and kiridx/ directories with all index files (_seq.fa and _coord.fa). Required if using T1K.

GermlinePipeline.threads.description: Number of threads for parallel processing

GermlinePipeline.trim_soft_clips.description: Trim soft-clipped bases from pileup images

GermlinePipeline.ua_parameters.description: UA parameters: v_aware_alignment_flag and ua_extra_args, recommended value set in the template

GermlinePipeline.ug_make_examples_cpus_o.description: CPU number override for make_examples step

GermlinePipeline.v_gpu_tile_size.description: Virtual GPU tile size for call_variants

GermlinePipeline.wgs_calling_interval_li.description: Optional override for the interval list defining the region to perform variant calling on. When not provided, resolved per genome from genome_resources (calling_interval_list_without_artefacts)
